text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Snap!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...So, how does it looky-look?
choice_data_list: Well, it turned out like this...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Pffft. What's up with my face?! I look<n>super
serious!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin came to me saying that<n>she wants to
send her family a photo<n>of herself wearing her
signature<n>racewear, so I'm helping her take the
picture.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. It is a funny picture, though!<n>Still, that's not
quite what I'm looking<n>for...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, can we go again? They've<n>been asking to
see a photo, so I'd<n>like to make it a good one...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, thankies! Okay, for the next<n>one...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Let's try this!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Or maybe... this!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: And if that doesn't work... get a loadof this!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... We've snapped a bunch of<n>pictures, but
none of them are clicking<n>with me...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We browse through all the photos<n>together, but I
have to agree...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... So we want a shot of me in my<n>signature
racewear, right? One that<n>says, "Look, I'm really
running!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Dad, Mom, my sisters... It's thanks to<n>their support
that I'm here.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: When they saw how much I lovedrunning, they cheered me on everystep of the way... So the thing I reallywant to show them would be...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: That's it! I've got it! Trainer, let's go<n>to the track!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Get ready, Trainer, I'm going to run atmy very best! My family gave me thepush I needed to sprint towards mydreams—and that's what I want toshow them!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
No retakes. We've got one shot here,<n>so make it
perfect! I'm counting on<n>you!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Okay, it's in your hands!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Rrraaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin shoots down the track as<n>if she's
racing for real. Though I<n>briefly fumble with the
camera, I<n>quickly lock my eyes on to her figure<n>and
take the shot.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Snap!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Phew! Did you get a goodone?!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Fully confident, I show her the picture<n>I took...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh... Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It shows Ines Fujin running as<n>passionately as she
does in real<n>races, and with sharp eyes locked
straight ahead. She looks cool, and is<n>clearly
enjoying the moment.
choice_data_list: Now this is how you were meant to flaunt that racewear!
Now this is how you were meant to flaunt that racewear!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... That's what was missing!<n>What an
awesome photo!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for all your help with this!<n>Hehe. Okay, time
to send this to my<n>folks!
choice_data_list: We really got the perfect shot!
We really got the perfect shot!
Why not send all the photos we took?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Why not send all the photos we took?
choice_data_list: We really got the perfect shot!
We really got the perfect shot!
Why not send all the photos we took?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I just know they'll love it!<n>Aaand... send.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Okay, now to get changed and train!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Wow, my mom's already replied!<n>Let's see...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks for the photo! It's a relief to<n>see you all
energized and having so<n>much fun."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Your sisters love how cool you look.<n>They've even
made this photo their<n>lock screen." Nice!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...I guess you really are the best at<n>capturing me in
the moment, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin is absolutely thrilled. It<n>looks like this
signature racewear<n>photo shoot has been a great
experience!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
What?! We can't! There are a few<n>weird ones in
there!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Like, there's one where... See, look!<n>I'm making a
heart with my hands in<n>this one, and I've got this
smug face<n>here! And there are others, too!
choice_data_list: None of them are as bad as you say...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: They are bad! I have a "dependableolder sister" image to maintain, youknow...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Okay, this stuff's staying between<n>us, Trainer! I've
got to sort these into<n>folders later.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And now to get changed for training!<n>I've got to
work hard if I want to look<n>cool in real races, too!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin dashes off confidently. As<n>she does, I
think about how I'll need<n>to keep supporting her so
she can<n>continue to run in style.
